system.description:
LIGHT SHAMAN SPIRIT UTILITY
Shaman Specialist Spell
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range 30 feet
Area 10-foot burst
Duration 1 minute

Pale light gathers around manifestations that do not fully belong to the physical world.
Disembodied spirits and incorporeal Undead within the area are outlined by the light. Creatures observing the area can perceive the location of those entities even if they do not possess a sense that would normally detect them.
Veil Lantern does not remove the Incorporeal trait, allow mundane weapons to harm creatures they could not ordinarily affect, identify a spirit, reveal its allegiance or Counteract Invisibility or Concealment produced by an unrelated effect.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: Increase the radius of the burst by 5 feet.
+4 PP: Affected spirits cannot benefit from Concealment arising specifically from their spiritual or incorporeal state while they remain within the area.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10.
